0.headline: Temperature sensors maker Tempsens Instruments to launch Rs 95 crore IPO on August 20
0.heading: Temperature sensors maker Tempsens Instruments to launch Rs 95 crore IPO on August 20
0.intro: Rajasthan-based Tempsens Instruments will open its IPO on August 20 to raise Rs 95 crore through a fresh issue, along with an OFS of 1.85 crore shares, with the price band to be announced next week.
0.body:
Rajasthan-based Tempsens Instruments, a manufacturer of contact and non-contact temperature sensors, will open its initial public offering (IPO) on August 20 to raise fresh capital of Rs 95 crore.

The IPO will also comprise an offer-for-sale (OFS) of 1.85 crore equity shares by existing shareholders, including promoters. The price band will be announced next Monday.

The IPO anchor book will open on August 19, while the offer will close for public subscription on August 24. The company is likely to finalise the IPO share allotment by August 25, with the equity shares expected to list on the stock exchanges on August 28.

Tempsens Instruments has reserved shares worth Rs 1.5 crore for its employees. Half of the net offer size, excluding the employee portion, has been reserved for qualified institutional buyers (QIBs), while 35 percent has been allocated to retail investors and the remaining 10 percent to non-institutional investors (NIIs).

The company intends to utilise Rs 18.1 crore of the net fresh issue proceeds to fund capital expenditure for its electrical heating solutions and specialised cable solutions businesses.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

Further, Rs 55 crore will be used to repay certain debt out of total consolidated outstanding borrowings of Rs 108.3 crore as of July 2026. The remaining funds will be used for general corporate purposes.

Tempsens Instruments claims to be the largest manufacturer of contact and non-contact temperature sensors in India by revenue, with a market share of approximately 10.5 percent in the temperature sensor segment. It also claims to be the only Indian manufacturer of non-contact temperature sensors, with approximately 21.3 percent of the non-contact temperature sensor market in FY26, according to the F&amp;S Report.

The thermal engineering and cable solutions provider has no comparable listed peer in India or overseas, according to the company. It operates 15 manufacturing units, including joint ventures, across the world, with 10 located in Udaipur and five overseas.

Promoters hold an 80.51 percent stake in the company, while the remainder is held by public shareholders, including WhiteOak Capital, which owns a 2.5 percent stake.

On the financial front, Tempsens Instruments reported a profit of Rs 71.1 crore for the year ended March 2026, up 13.6 percent from Rs 62.6 crore in the previous year. Revenue rose 17.5 percent to Rs 444.9 crore from Rs 378.5 crore.

ICICI Securities and JM Financial have been appointed as merchant bankers for the Tempsens Instruments IPO.

1.headline: Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop parent Purple Style Labs plans Rs 660-crore IPO by August-end
1.heading: Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop parent Purple Style Labs plans Rs 660-crore IPO by August-end
1.intro: Purple Style Labs, which operates Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop, has filed updated IPO papers after receiving SEBI approval earlier this year.
1.body:
Purple Style Labs Limited, the parent of Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop, one of India’s largest and fastest-growing multi-brand luxury omni-channel fashion platforms is planning to launch its IPO by the end of August.

The company has filed its updated DRHP with SEBI, sources close to the matter said. The company received its SEBI approval in January 2026.

The IPO comes amid strong growth in India’s wedding and luxury consumption markets. India’s wedding industry has crossed Rs 10 lakh crore, with wedding wear alone projected to reach Rs 3.4 lakh crore by FY30, while the personal luxury market is expected to reach Rs 2.31 lakh crore. This rising demand is creating opportunities for multi-designer platforms that combine discovery, commerce and distribution.

Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop has over 1,300 designers and over two lakh products across its digital platform and 14 experience centres. It recorded FY25 gross merchandise value of over ₹588 crore, with an average order value of Rs 56,106 and repeat customers accounting for up to 28 percent, reflecting a shift towards higher-value customers.

The company recorded more than 11x revenue growth, from Rs 45 crore million in FY20 to Rs 5,08 crore in FY2024, translating into an approximately 83 percent CAGR..

Promoted by Abhishek Agarwal, who holds a 27.10 percent stake, Purple Style Labs is backed by a diversified base of institutional investors like Akash Bhanshali, Mukul Agarwal, and Singularity, family offices, private investors and publicly disclosed celebrity investors, including Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan and family, Sachin Tendulkar, Madhuri Dixit and Mahesh Babu.

The company is also expanding its marquee retail footprint, with the flagship Pernia’s Pop-Up Studio at Fort, Mumbai, and experience centres on Linking Road, Mumbai and Madison Avenue, New York.

Axis Capital and IIFL Capital are advising the company on its IPO.
1.ai_impact_text_summary_s: Purple Style Labs (Pernia's Pop-Up Shop) plans an IPO by end of August, driven by India's booming luxury market. The company, with strong financials and celebrity backing, has filed its DRHP and received SEBI approval. Axis Capital and IIFL Capital are advising.

2.headline: Horizon Industrial Parks raises Rs 1,168 crore from anchors ahead of Rs 2,600-crore IPO
2.heading: Horizon Industrial Parks raises Rs 1,168 crore from anchors ahead of Rs 2,600-crore IPO
2.intro: Horizon Industrial Parks IPO | The Rs 2,600-crore initial public offering is set to open for public subscription on August 17 and close on August 19.
2.body:
Blackstone-backed Horizon Industrial Parks has raised Rs 1,167.8 crore from 54 anchor investors, including Morgan Stanley, Carmignac, Millennium Management, Societe Generale, Citigroup Global and Viridian Asset Management, ahead of its Rs 2,600-crore initial public offering (IPO).

The industrial and logistics infrastructure developer allocated 19.46 crore equity shares to anchor investors at the upper end of its IPO price band of Rs 57-60 per share on August 14.

The IPO will open for public subscription on August 17 and close on August 19. The issue comprises entirely a fresh issue of shares.

Horizon Industrial Parks is owned and managed by three Blackstone affiliates, which collectively hold an 88.74 percent stake in the company.

Mutual funds, insurers participate

Of the total anchor allocation, 3.88 crore shares were allotted to six domestic mutual funds, including WhiteOak Capital, Sundaram Mutual Fund, 360 ONE, PGIM India, JM Financial and Edelweiss, through 27 schemes.

SBI Life Insurance and Edelweiss Life Insurance were allocated another 1.24 crore shares worth Rs 75 crore.

Click Here To Read All IPO News

Debt repayment gets bulk of IPO proceeds

Horizon Industrial Parks plans to use Rs 2,250 crore of the net proceeds from the IPO to repay debt. The remaining funds will be used for general corporate purposes.

The company had outstanding borrowings of Rs 6,884.3 crore as of March 2026.

Despite a sharp increase in revenue, the company's loss widened in FY26. Net loss rose to Rs 203.6 crore from Rs 178.7 crore in FY25, while revenue increased 77.1 percent to Rs 691.4 crore from Rs 390.3 crore.

Pan-India logistics network

Horizon Industrial Parks is India's largest industrial and logistics infrastructure developer and operator, offering Grade A warehouses, industrial facilities and in-city centres across major industrial and consumption hubs.

Its services also include cold storage, energy solutions, on-site staff accommodation, racking and material-handling equipment.

The company operates 45 assets across 10 cities, including Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad and Nagpur.

JM Financial, Axis Capital, IIFL Capital Services, SBI Capital Markets and 360 ONE WAM are the merchant bankers managing the IPO.
